# `7_Aeolus.txt`

Text of the "Aeolus" episode of James Joyce's *Ulysses*, manually
edited/extracted by Jasper Harrington from his preferred edition.

`results/` holds promoted runs, one directory per run
(`<YYYYMMDD-HHMMSS>_v<version>/`) containing `results.csv` and `models.csv`.
Read them with `list_runs()` and `read_run()`.
